title: Conflict Banner
summary: Names who changed a record while you were editing and shows the difference, so nobody silently overwrites a teammate's edit.
description: Names who changed the record and when, shows a word diff, and before "Keep mine" confirms how many of their words it would replace, until you've compared.
catches: Saving over a newer version from someone else
Unseen differences, via a word diff
How much of the other person's work "Keep mine" would discard
Versions that turn out to be identical
limits: Needs both versions and the editor from your backend; it doesn't detect conflicts itself
The diff is word-level on plain text
a11y: role="region" with an aria-label naming the editor
Message is aria-live="polite"; the compare toggle uses aria-expanded
The overwrite confirmation is a labelled group; focus moves to Cancel and Escape closes it
server: Detect conflicts on the server with a version or ETag check, and reject stale writes unless overwrite is explicit.
